notes: Dockerfile.final is structurally sound and ready for Buildah validation. The Dockerfile uses rust:1-slim base image with proper apt-get package installation. Both build-context scripts (setup_runtime.sh, repo_setup.sh) are present in /artifacts/environment/. The repo_setup.sh script materializes /workspace from git at build time. setup_runtime.sh builds Rust dependencies and eBPF programs. eval.sh and hidden tests are treated as runtime-mounted verifier assets and are not baked into the image. Final WORKDIR is /workspace as required.
